label: canon-c19-e2soft-n2
_why: BATCH 1 OF THE FOUR-BATCH PLAN PROPOSED 2026-09-16 (HANDOVER.md; awaiting the user's go-ahead - NOT to be launched without it): THE 1890-1910 DIP, ONE LEVER. The found configuration canon-c19-in12 (F117 + F120: four seeds at 1.04-1.13x vanilla GDP and 0.64-0.70x workers per capita, both in band) tracks vanilla to 1860 and then dips to 0.75x / 0.89x at 1900 and 0.86 / 0.95 at 1910 before realigning by the 1930s - deeper than the -20% the user tolerated for the early decades, and never ruled on. F117's own reading of the dip is that the e2 rungs are still too dear to fill: an e2 level costs 1.9x an e1 level (2,166 vs 1,140 in the 600-class) while its technology is fresh, and the switch that is free in vanilla is a construction bill here - the premise's own capital deficit. The cost-slope sweep changed every era's cost together (C 1.6: e2 at 1,536, on vanilla's path to 1890 then 1.12 / 1.27 / 1.59x at 1900 / 1910 / 1920 - a runaway carried first by e2 and then by e3 at 2,458; C 1.9: the dip). THIS BOOK MOVES THE e2 RUNG'S COST ALONE: 2,166 -> 1,850 (600-class), 2,888 -> 2,466 (800-class), 1,444 -> 1,233 (the academy), i.e. the geometric midpoint between C 1.6's e2 and C 1.9's, with e1 (1,140) and e3 (4,115) exactly the found book's - so the early game and the late loop are untouched and only the 1890-1910 transition is cheaper. Expressed as the new per-era cost list `make_ab_config --cost-ladder 1.9,3.083,6.859` (F127 / CLAUDE.md), which the L31 lint reads.

_predictions._structure: Pre-registered before launch, per the no-extrapolation rule. The dip is read on the decade series (the ledger's GDP / vanilla per decade), the endpoint on alignment_check.mjs.
_predictions.KEY_the_dip: THE TEST: the pair's MEAN world GDP / vanilla at 1900 at or above 0.90 (the found pair 0.75 / 0.89, mean 0.82) and at 1910 at or above 1.00 (found 0.86 / 0.95). A pair mean at or below 0.82 at 1900 is a NULL - the dip is not the e2 rung's price - and the branch is the cheaper e2 (1,700; m2 = 2.833) once, then the question closes.
_predictions.endpoint: world GDP 1.05-1.25x vanilla at 1935 and workers per capita 0.65-0.75x. THE RUN-LEVEL STOP APPLIES: a run above 1.3x at 1936 ends the configuration; that outcome is the pre-registered signal that a cheaper e2 feeds the late loop after all, and the branch is e2 at 2,000 (m2 = 3.333).
_predictions.e2_fill: e2 STAFFED levels at 1920 at or above 3,300 world-wide (the found book 2,739 / 2,800), tiered levels at 1935 11,000-14,000 (found 9,917-10,633).
_predictions.rung0_UNCHANGED: This book does not touch the old rung: rung 0 at 42-50% staffed, 3.0-3.8M workers world-wide (found 45% / 3.3-3.4M), its value added per worker 1-5% of the frontier's (F127). A move here would be the economy's size showing through (F124 §4), not an effect of the lever.
_predictions.hoard_and_flags: pools 0.4-0.7 of world GDP (found 0.42-0.64), neither persistent-hoarding test fires; the capital-abundance flag as the found book's (Britain alone may trip it, as vanilla's own Britain does in 2 of 16 seeds); shortlist-wide = VOID.
_predictions.perf: row P total within +10% of the vanilla median; the feeder handles a mid-autosave CTD (L32).

_alignment: THE 2+1 RULE (user-ruled 2026-09-14, F114): after run 2, `node tools/testbed/ledger/alignment_check.mjs --arm <session>:canon-c19-e2soft` - world GDP and productive workers per capita at 1935 against the vanilla per-run median, five bands each; a pair fails an axis only in different bands AND >= 0.15 (GDP) / >= 0.10 (workers) apart. DIVERGENT => canon_c19_e2soft_tb.json as its own session, the reading the median of three. PLUS THE RUN-LEVEL STOP and THE CAPITAL-ABUNDANCE FLAG (`capital_flags.mjs`, shortlist-wide = VOID, exit 4).
_comparison: vanilla n=18 for every ratio; canon-c19-in12 is the one-lever baseline (F117 sessions 20260914_173832 + 20260914_204329; F120's pair is the same economy with rung 0's ai_value halved): decade series 0.96 / 1.03 (1860), 0.84 / 0.91 (1880), 0.75 / 0.89 (1900), 0.86 / 0.95 (1910), 0.91 / 0.94 (1920), 1.04 / 0.94 (1930), 1.09 / 1.07 (1935); workers 0.65 / 0.67; rung 0 45%; hoard 0.64 / 0.42.
_branches: Above 1.3x at 1936 in any run -> the config ends (the stop); next = e2 at 2,000 (--cost-ladder 1.9,3.333,6.859). The 1900 mean at or below 0.82 -> null; one more step at e2 = 1,700 (--cost-ladder 1.9,2.833,6.859), then close. Dip filled AND the endpoint in band -> this book replaces canon-c19-in12 as the base for batches 2-3 and is confirmed in batch 4.

_caveats: n=2 by design; the alignment tool decides on the third.

Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30); the STOP file must be absent; the five-minute smoke check on EVERY run; never interleave configs (one schedule = one config).
The 1900 reading swings 0.14 between the found book's two seeds, which is why the KEY prediction is on the pair's MEAN, not on either run.
